# anecdotes_controls (Data Source)

Lists all controls for a given framework, with optional filtering by category, name, or status.

> **Note:** To read controls created in the same configuration, add `depends_on`
> to this data source so Terraform reads it only after those controls exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_controls" "soc2" {
  framework_id = "fw_12345"
}

output "control_count" {
  value = data.anecdotes_controls.soc2.total_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `framework_id` (String) The framework ID to list controls for. Required.

### Optional

- `category_id` (String) Filter controls by category ID.
- `name_contains` (String) Filter controls whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).
- `status` (String) Filter controls by status. Valid values: "NOT_STARTED", "IN_PROGRESS", "READY_FOR_AUDIT", "GAP", "ISSUE", "APPROVED_BY_AUDITOR", "MONITORING", "NOT_APPLICABLE", "NOT_READY_FOR_AUDIT", "INSUFFICIENT_DATA", "UNDER_REVIEW".

### Read-Only

- `controls` (Attributes List) List of controls matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controls))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of controls matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--controls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `controls`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The control category name.
- `category_id` (String) The control category ID.
- `control_id` (String) The unique identifier of the control.
- `description` (String) The description of the control.
- `framework_id` (String) The framework this control belongs to.
- `name` (String) The name of the control.
- `owners` (List of String) List of control owners.
- `status` (String) The control status.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags applied to this control.
